layers.label: Resident density (residents/km²)
layers.why: Cafés need resident footfall; registered-resident density is the cheapest proxy.

layers.label: Residents aged 18–45 (share)
layers.why: Young adults are the core café audience.

layers.label: Existing cafés (OSM)
layers.why: Mapped cafés in the cell; separate inventory from IHK, never summed.

layers.label: Registered cafés (IHK 56114/561141)
layers.why: IHK-registered cafés in the cell; separate inventory from OSM, never summed.

layers.label: Scheduled departures 07–10 (supply, not footfall)
layers.why: Morning scheduled departures within 400 m indicate commuter flow past the cell; this is scheduled supply, not measured footfall.
